projects.title: Nuwal Pool Design

projects.title: Outer Seating — Brijesh Residence
projects.shortDescription: An outdoor seating area designed as an extension of the living space for a private residence in Jaipur.
projects.description: Designed as a thoughtful outdoor extension of the residence's living area, this 300 sq ft seating space for Brijesh Ji in Jaipur brings together comfortable proportions, shade, and greenery to create a relaxed outdoor living experience.

projects.title: Pool Area — Achint Jain Residence
projects.shortDescription: A private pool area for Achint Ji Jain's residence in Jaipur, designed to complement the architecture with clean landscape detailing.
projects.description: A 430 sq ft pool area for Achint Ji Jain's private residence in Jaipur. The design emphasizes clean geometry and landscape detailing that complements the residential architecture, creating a private aquatic retreat within the property.

projects.title: Courtyard Planning — Rajnesh Residence
projects.shortDescription: Courtyard landscape planning for Rajnesh Ji's private residence in Kholpur, creating a serene and functional outdoor gathering space.
projects.description: A 280 sq ft courtyard planning project for Rajnesh Ji's private residence in Kholpur, Rajasthan. The design transforms the central courtyard into a calm, functional outdoor space — integrating planting, paving, and seating that respond to the residential context and Rajasthan's climate.
